text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- King Hassan presides over working session with Moroccan team which will meet U.N. special envoy on the Western Sahara, James Baker, in Lisbon in attempt to break deadlock over referendum in the region.
- World Food Programme grants Morocco $16 million for rural school canteens.
- French ambassador in Rabat says his country will ease visa procedures for Moroccans.
- Crown Prince Mohamed to attend United Nations Earth Summit in New York.
- Socialism and Progress Party (PPS) heads 28 local councils.
